1: # BK7258 OpenVela UART0 Mailbox V2完整收发移植方案
2: 
3: ## 1. 文档目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文是`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`中UART0和Mailbox V2章节的可实施细化方案。依据当前工作区的OpenVela AP实现、`bk_avdk_smp` AP/CP源码、比赛仓CP覆盖文件、原厂网页文档和生成的内存布局，目标是在不占用CPU1物理UART1、不改变CP物理UART0下载和启动行为的前提下，实现：
6: 
7: ```text
8: AP/OpenVela输出
9:   NuttX console/syslog/NSH stdout
10:     -> AP MB_UART0 TX
11:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x19
12:     -> CP MB_UART0 RX
13:     -> CP shell TX queue
14:     -> CP UART0/GPIO11/CH340/PC
15: 
16: PC输入
17:   PC/CH340/UART0 RX/GPIO10
18:     -> CP shell UART RX owner
19:     -> 显式AP console输入模式
20:     -> CP MB_UART0 TX
21:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x49
22:     -> AP MB_UART0 RX
23:     -> NuttX serial upper-half
24:     -> /dev/console/NSH stdin
25: ```
26: 
27: 最终结论：
28: 
29: - `MB_UART0`本身是全双工、带软件RTS/CTS流控的虚拟UART，不是单向日志命令。
30: - AP发送使用logical channel `0x19`，CP发送使用logical channel `0x49`；两者都是同一个MB_UART0的本端发送编号。
31: - 每个Mailbox V2 envelope只携带16字节message的地址和长度；DATA message再携带固定128字节交换区的地址和有效长度。
32: - 当前本地AP实现只完成AP到CP的输出；收到CP DATA后固定返回成功但不复制数据。当前CP覆盖也只读取AP输出，没有PC到AP输入路径。
33: - 完整移植必须同时修改OpenVela AP和Armino CP。只补AP RX或只调用CP `bk_mb_uart_write()`都不能形成完整控制台。
34: - 正式实现保持原厂16字节message、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS线协议兼容，但必须修复本地实现的buffer所有权、ACK队列、reset、RX校验和NuttX serial接入问题；不得照搬原厂未初始化尾字节、未校验payload指针和失败后静默丢包等缺陷。
35: 
36: ## 2. 基线、范围和非目标
37: 
38: ### 2.1 开发和交付目录
39: 
40: - OpenVela AP开发目录：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/`。
41: - OpenVela board配置：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/`。
42: - CP可复现覆盖的权威副本：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/`。
43: - CP实际构建树：`bk_avdk_smp/`。CP改动必须先落权威副本，再按该目录`README.md`同步到构建树并逐字节检查。
44: - `bk_idk`、`bk_solution_ai`、`vendor_beken`和网页文档仅作为参考，不是BK7258 OpenVela正式开发目录。
45: 
46: ### 2.2 本轮范围
47: 
48: - Mailbox V2 CPU1 channel 1物理收发、IRQ79、FIFO drain和错误恢复。
49: - CPU1到CPU0 logical channel复用调度，至少不破坏HW_CTRL、PWC和UART0。
50: - AP侧MB_UART0 DATA/STATE、双向ring、流控、ACK和NuttX serial lower-half。
51: - CP侧MB_UART0接收输出和UART0输入转发。
52: - CP CLI与AP NSH对唯一UART0输入的显式所有权切换。
53: - 冷启动、AP重启、CP重启、Mailbox reset和压力验收。
54: 
55: ### 2.3 非目标
56: 
57: - 不启用CPU1物理UART1，不切换GPIO0/1，不要求第二个USB-TTL。
58: - 不用`MB_CHNL_LOG`的`MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`替代逐字节TTY。该协议只能转发完整Armino CLI命令，不具备NSH readline、退格和Ctrl-C语义。
59: - 不修改bootloader下载串口协议。AP console接管只能发生在CP运行期，并且必须在AP ready以后。
60: - 不承诺在Mailbox IRQ和调度器可用前输出启动日志。panic时若中断关闭，MB_UART也不能工作；原厂文档同样明确其不是无中断polling UART。
61: - 第一版不启用MB_UART CRC8。原厂当前配置下CRC恒为0；单边启用会不兼容。保留字段并校验其为0，后续只能在AP/CP同时升级后启用。
62: 
63: ## 3. 已确认的协议事实
64: 
65: ### 3.1 CPU和logical channel编码
66: 
67: logical channel为8位：
68: 
69: ```text
70: bit[7:6] destination CPU
71: bit[5:4] source CPU
72: bit[3:0] logical channel index
73: ```
74: 
75: CPU0/CP为0，CPU1/AP为1。UART0的组内index为9，因此：
76: 
77: | 本端 | 方向 | 发送channel | 接收报文中的channel |
78: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
79: | AP/OpenVela | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x19` | `0x49` |
80: | CP/Armino | CPU0 -> CPU1 | `0x49` | `0x19` |
81: 
82: 参考：
83: 
84: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32-44,53,77-96`
85: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29-41,49,64-83`
86: 
87: 不得将`0x19`和`0x49`理解为两个独立UART，也不得用IPC `0x10`、PWC `0x12/0x42`或`MB_CHNL_LOG`承载UART字节流。
88: 
89: ### 3.2 Mailbox V2 envelope
90: 
91: MBOX0硬件FIFO中的两个data word是：
92: 
93: | FIFO word | 含义 |
94: | --- | --- |
95: | `data[0]` | 发送端稳定16字节message的32位地址 |
96: | `data[1]` | 固定为16 |
97: 
98: 接收端根据硬件SID确认源CPU，再复制16字节message。AP接收的message地址来自CP拥有的稳定SRAM，CP接收的地址来自AP拥有的稳定SRAM。不能让FIFO引用栈变量，也不能在对端复制前复用或改写该slot。
99: 
100: ### 3.3 16字节message header
101: 
102: word0布局固定如下：
103: 
104: ```text
105: bit[7:0]   cmd
106: bit[11:8]  state
107: bit[15:12] ctrl
108: bit[23:16] tx_seq
109: bit[31:24] logical_chnl
110: ```
111: 
112: `ctrl`定义：
113: 
114: | 位 | 名称 | 语义 |
115: | ---: | --- | --- |
116: | 0 | `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX` | 1表示transport ACK，0表示command |
117: | 1 | `CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX` | 无ACK同步发送；正式UART普通路径不使用 |
118: | 2 | `CHNL_CTRL_RESET` | transport重同步 |
119: 
120: `state bit0`为`CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。ACK必须至少匹配`source/destination + logical_chnl + tx_seq + cmd`，不匹配的ACK只能计为stale/bad ACK，不能释放当前事务。
121: 
122: ### 3.4 MB_UART message布局
123: 
124: 协议运行于ARM32 little-endian。不得在OpenVela实现中继续依赖编译器bitfield，使用显式mask/shift和定宽字段。
125: 
126: DATA/STATE command为16字节：
127: 
128: | offset | 大小 | 字段 |
129: | ---: | ---: | --- |
130: | 0 | 1 | `cmd`：DATA=0，STATE=1 |
131: | 1 | 1 | state/ctrl，发送command时初始为0 |
132: | 2 | 1 | transport sequence |
133: | 3 | 1 | logical channel |
134: | 4 | 4 | DATA交换buffer地址；STATE为0 |
135: | 8 | 2 | DATA有效长度0..128；STATE为0 |
136: | 10 | 1 | bit0=`uart_rts`，其余必须0 |
137: | 11 | 1 | `crc8`，当前兼容值为0 |
138: | 12 | 4 | 保留，必须清0 |
139: 
140: ACK为同一个16字节slot的响应语义：
141: 
142: | offset | 含义 |
143: | ---: | --- |
144: | 0..3 | 原cmd、state，加ACK ctrl、sequence和channel |
145: | 4 bit0 | 接收端当前`uart_rts` |
146: | 4 bit1 | `uart_tx_fail`，本DATA整包未接收 |
147: | 4 bit7:2 | 0 |
148: | 5..15 | 0 |
149: 
150: 所有command和ACK结构在构造前必须`memset(..., 0, 16)`，避免原厂实现中offset 12..15栈残留和ACK尾部旧数据泄漏。
151: 
152: ### 3.5 UART0交换区和所有权
153: 
154: 项目RAM布局固定预留：
155: 
156: ```text
157: SWAP = 0x2809f800..0x2809ffff, size 0x800
158: ```
159: 
160: 来自：
161: 
162: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`
163: - 生成的`ram_regions.h`中`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR=0x2809f800`、`CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE=0x800`
164: 
165: 每个支持共享payload的logical channel占`0x200`字节，顺序为HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1。每个方向/CPU slot为128字节。当前CPU0/CPU1 UART0精确映射为：
166: 
167: | 地址 | owner/方向 | AP视角 |
168: | --- | --- | --- |
169: | `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f` | CP host_tx[CPU1] | AP RX payload，只读后复制 |
170: | `0x2809fc80..0x2809fcff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
171: | `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f` | AP host_rx[CPU1] | AP TX payload，ACK前保持不变 |
172: | `0x2809fd80..0x2809fdff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
173: 
174: OpenVela linker必须新增独立`SWAP` memory region，地址/长度来自与CP相同的生成配置，并将其标记为`NOLOAD`。不能把SWAP并入AP heap，不能由AP启动代码清零整个SWAP，也不能在AP `.bss`另建一个“看起来等价”的交换buffer。
175: 
176: 首版将SWAP和双方message slot窗口映射为shareable、non-cacheable、RW/XN。若后续启用D-cache，所有ownership交接统一由共享内存API执行：发布前clean + DMB，读取前invalidate + DMB，ACK后才复用；cache line为32字节，操作必须向外对齐且不能误刷相邻owner数据。
177: 
178: ## 4. 当前实现差距
179: 
180: ### 4.1 AP侧
181: 
182: 当前`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`具备基础`0x19/0x49`分派、AP TX ring和transport ACK匹配，但存在以下交付阻断项：
183: 
184: 1. `MB_CHNL_UART0_RX`只检查DATA/STATE后固定返回`uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0`，不校验、不复制CP payload，输入被静默丢弃。
185: 2. 没有MB_UART RX ring、RTS高低水位、STATE发送和对端RTS/CTS门控。
186: 3. AP TX payload使用普通AP `.bss`中的`g_uart_xchg`，没有复用原厂SWAP地址和跨核固定所有权。
187: 4. 单个`g_ack_message`在FIFO full时可被下一条RX覆盖。
188: 5. ACK超时后清busy并原地改sequence重发同一buffer，会造成旧FIFO envelope观察到新内容、重复日志和非幂等PWC重复执行。
189: 6. reset只清physical busy，没有终止/失败完成active transaction、修复UART inflight或向CP重新同步。
190: 7. 初始化在注册IRQ后直接丢弃RX FIFO，已到达command得不到ACK，可能令CP永久busy。
191: 8. envelope仅白名单CP普通RAM，payload还需要独立SWAP精确白名单。
192: 9. logical channel和MB_UART混在一个文件，无法清晰复用和测试状态机。
193: 10. 仅`up_irq_save()`适用于当前单核AP；进入NuttX SMP后不能阻止CPU2并发。
194: 
195: 当前`bk7258_serial.c`的`receive()`固定返回-1、`rxavailable()`固定false、`rxint()`为空，因而`read()`、`poll(POLLIN)`和NSH均无输入。设备同时冒充硬件UART1并注册`/dev/ttyS1`，Kconfig/defconfig也错误命名为UART1。

197: 当前`bk7258_syslog.c`忽略实际写入结果并总是返回全部长度，单次`size_t`还隐式截断为`uint16_t`；`force`与普通路径相同，不能提供panic flush保证。

254: ## 6. AP Mailbox V2 transport设计
255: 
256: ### 6.1 物理层
257: 
258: CPU1只配置自己拥有的channel 1：FIFO start=2、length=3，接收IRQ source 63映射到NuttX IRQ79。物理层初始化必须在`up_initialize()`可使用NuttX IRQ API后、board late逻辑服务前完成。
259: 
260: ISR固定执行：
261: 
262: 1. 读取并累计`wrerr/rderr/wrfull`等W1C错误状态。
263: 2. 循环读取FIFO直到empty，不能每次中断只取一个。
264: 3. 校验SID为CPU0、length为16、地址4字节对齐、`address + 16`无溢出且位于允许的CP message窗口。
265: 4. 立即复制到AP-owned RX descriptor queue，随后上层处理；不能长期持有CP message指针。
266: 5. 若RX descriptor queue或ACK资源不足，停止继续drain并保留中断，不能读出后无ACK丢弃。
267: 
268: 初始化时不再盲目drain。应先安装logical callback和RX/ACK资源，再处理已有FIFO。无法识别的有效command也必须返回`COM_FAIL` ACK。
269: 
270: ### 6.2 稳定transaction slot
271: 
272: 每个CPU0物理方向同时只允许一个command in-flight，以兼容原厂physical BUSY模型。实现至少准备：
273: 
274: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
275: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
276: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
277: - message slot 32字节对齐，地址必须位于AP RAM白名单；payload SWAP另行校验。
278: 
279: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
280: 
281: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
282: 
283: 收到ACK后完整检查：
284: 
285: ```text
286: SID == CPU0
287: ACK_BOX == 1
288: logical_channel == active.channel
289: tx_seq == active.seq
290: cmd == active.cmd
291: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
292: ```
293: 
294: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
295: 
296: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
297: 
298: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
299: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送RESET重同步；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
300: 3. reset完成或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
301: 4. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
302: 5. reset仍失败则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
303: 
304: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；reset建立新的epoch。不能仅靠sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK，DOWN/RESETTING状态下只接受reset相关消息。
305: 
306: ### 6.4 reset方向
307: 
308: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次RESET，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。收到CP RESET时：
309: 
310: - 对当前active生成`-ECONNRESET` completion并释放，不继续假定旧ACK会到达。
311: - 清理ACK queue、physical busy和peer RTS已知状态。
312: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
313: - 返回RESET ACK，再由MB_UART互发STATE恢复流控。
314: 
315: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
316: 
317: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
318: 
319: ### 7.1 控制块
320: 
321: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
322: 
323: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
324: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
325: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
326: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
327: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
328: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
329: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
330: - link状态：DOWN/RESETTING/READY/QUIESCING。
331: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
332: 
333: ### 7.2 AP发送
334: 
335: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
336: 
337: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
338: 
339: ```text
340: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
341: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
342: uart_rts     = local_rts
343: crc8         = 0
344: reserved     = 0
345: ```
346: 
347: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
348: 
349: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
350: 
351: ### 7.3 AP接收
352: 
353: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
354: 
355: DATA必须同时满足：
356: 
357: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
358: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
359: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
360: - 当前link允许接收。
361: 
362: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
363: 
364: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
365: 
366: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
367: 
368: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
369: 
370: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
371: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
372: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
373: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
374: 
375: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。建议同时启用`CONFIG_SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`和`rxflowcontrol`，当NuttX upper-half满时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；upper-half恢复后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。
376: 
377: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
378: 
379: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
380: 
381: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
382: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
383: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
384: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
385: 
386: `uart_ops_s`实现：
387: 
388: | op | 行为 |
389: | --- | --- |
390: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
391: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
392: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
393: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
394: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
395: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
396: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
397: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
398: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
399: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
400: 
401: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
402: 
403: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
404: 
405: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
406: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
407: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
408: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
409: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
410: 
411: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
412: 
413: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
414: 
415: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
416: 
417: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
418: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
419: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
420: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
421: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
422: 
423: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
424: 
425: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
426: 
427: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
428: 
429: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
430: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
431: 
432: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
433: 
434: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
435: 
436: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
437: 
438: ```text
439: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
440: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
441: ```
442: 
443: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
444: 
445: - AP已完成Mailbox reset/state握手。
446: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
447: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
448: 
449: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`进入，打印一次模式切换提示后不再添加协议文字。AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH，退出后恢复CP prompt。
450: 
451: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
452: 
453: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
454: 
455: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
456: 
457: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
458: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
459: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
460: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
461: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
462: 
463: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。
464: 
465: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
466: 
467: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
468: 
469: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
470: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
471: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
472: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
473: 
474: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
475: 
476: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
477: 
478: ### 9.1 CP时序
479: 
480: ```text
481: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
482:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
483:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
484:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
485:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
486:   -> 启动AP
487:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
488:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
489:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
490: ```
491: 
492: ### 9.2 AP时序
493: 
494: ```text
495: CPU1 reset
496:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
497:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
498:   -> up_initialize中初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
499:   -> 初始化logical transport和ACK pool
500:   -> 主动RESET CP旧事务并等待有界完成
501:   -> 初始化MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
502:   -> 发送STATE(local_rts=0)
503:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
504:   -> 启动Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker
505:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
506:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
507:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
508:   -> 启动NSH
509: ```
510: 
511: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次握手。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
512: 
513: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
514: 
515: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
516: 
517: 实现PM后流程：
518: 
519: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
520: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送RESET、重新交换STATE，再恢复DATA。
521: - AP重启：AP主动RESET；CP bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成，自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
522: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入RESETTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新握手。

614: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
615: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
616: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
617: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
618: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
619: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
620: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
621: 
622: ### 12.3 故障和并发
623: 
624: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
625: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
626: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
627: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
628: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
629: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
630: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新reset/state握手，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
631: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
632: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
633: 
634: ### 12.4 最低可观察结果
635: 
636: ```text
637: CP boot...
638: ap0: OpenVela mailbox uart ready
639: cp> ap_console open
640: nsh> uname -a
641: ...
642: nsh>                         # 行首 Ctrl-] .
643: AP console closed
644: cp>
645: ```
646: 
647: 统计命令至少输出：link/mode、peer/local RTS、TX/RX ring occupancy、active channel/seq/cmd、DATA/STATE计数、drop、overflow、remote fail、bad envelope/payload/ACK、timeout和reset次数。
648: 
649: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
650: 
651: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
652: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
653: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
654: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
655: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
656: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
657: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。

176: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_cnt = 0;
177: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_cnt = 0;
178: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt = 0;
179:

181: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt = 0;

183: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
184: {
185: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
186: 	
187: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
188: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
189: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
190: 	
191: 	return ret_code;
192: }
193: 
194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }
258: 
259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }
375: 
376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{
481: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}
487: }

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }

588: 	u16 				chnl_type;
589: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	cmd_buf = {0};
590: 
591: 	if(SELF_CPU == dst_cpu)
592: 	{
593: 		return BK_OK;
594: 	}

596: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;

599: 	cmd_buf.hdr.ctrl |= (CHNL_CTRL_RESET | CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX);

602: 	bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)&cmd_buf, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
603: 
604: 	return BK_OK;

607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }

200: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
201: {
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
203: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
204: 	u16 			chnl_type;
205: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
206: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
207: 
208: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
209: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
210: 
211: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
212: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
213: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
214: 		return 4;
215: #endif
216: 
217: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
218: 		return 5;
219: 
220: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
221: 		return 3;
222: 
223: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
224: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
225: 
226: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
227: 		return 1;
228: 
229: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;

563: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
564: {
565: 	u8		ret_code;
566: 
567: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
568: 
569: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
570: 
571: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
572: 
573: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
574: 		return;
575: 
576: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
577: 		return;
578: 
579: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
580: 
581: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
582: 	{
583: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
584: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
585: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
586: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
587: 
588: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
589: 
590: 		if(ret_code != 0)
591: 		{
592: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
593: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
594: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
595: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
596: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
597: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
598: 
599: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
600: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
601: 			}
602: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
603: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	return;
608: }

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

298: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
299: {
300: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)

191: 	}
192: 	else

195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}

266:

335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;

490: 	}

492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;

495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)

497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;

542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;

549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;

138: static void uart_prepare(void)
139: {
140:   struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[2];
141:   uint16_t count;
142:   uint16_t first;
143: 
144:   if (channel->pending || g_uart_inflight != 0)
145:     {
146:       return;
147:     }
148: 
149:   if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - g_uart_retry_after) < 0)
150:     {
151:       return;
152:     }
153: 
154:   count = uart_count();
155:   if (count == 0)
156:     {
157:       return;
158:     }
159: 
160:   if (count > UART_XCHG_SIZE)
161:     {
162:       count = UART_XCHG_SIZE;
163:     }
164: 
165:   first = UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart_read;
166:   if (first > count)
167:     {
168:       first = count;
169:     }

171:   memcpy(g_uart_xchg, &g_uart_tx[g_uart_read], first);
172:   if (first != count)
173:     {
174:       memcpy(&g_uart_xchg[first], g_uart_tx, count - first);
175:     }
176: 
177:   channel->message.header = 0; /* MB_UART_SEND_DATA */
178:   channel->message.param1 = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)g_uart_xchg;
179:   channel->message.param2 = count;
180:   channel->message.param3 = 0; /* RTS deasserted, CRC disabled by Armino. */
181:   channel->pending = true;
182:   g_uart_inflight = count;

185: static int dispatch_locked(void)
186: {
187:   struct logical_channel *channel;
188:   uint32_t wire[2];
189:   clock_t now;
190:   unsigned int i;
191:   int ret;
192: 
193:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
194:   if (g_phy_busy && now - g_busy_since >= PHY_BUSY_TIMEOUT)
195:     {
196:       g_stats.ack_timeout++;
197:       g_phy_busy = false;
198:     }
199: 
200:   if (g_phy_busy)
201:     {
202:       return OK;
203:     }
204: 
205:   if (g_ack_wire[0] != 0)
206:     {
207:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire);
208:       if (ret < 0)
209:         {
210:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:             {
212:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
213:             }
214: 
215:           return ret;
216:         }
217: 
218:       g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
219:       g_stats.tx_count++;
220:     }
221: 
222:   uart_prepare();
223:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(g_channel_ids); i++)
224:     {
225:       channel = &g_channels[i];
226:       if (!channel->pending)
227:         {
228:           continue;
229:         }
230: 
231:       g_active_channel = g_channel_ids[i];
232:       g_active_seq = ++g_tx_seq;
233:       channel->message.header &= 0xffu;
234:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_seq << 16;
235:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_channel << 24;
236:       wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&channel->message;
237:       wire[1] = sizeof(channel->message);
238:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
239:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
240:       if (ret < 0)
241:         {
242:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
243:             {
244:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
245:             }
246: 
247:           return ret;
248:         }
249: 
250:       g_phy_busy = true;
251:       g_busy_since = now;
252:       g_stats.tx_count++;
253:       return OK;
254:     }
255: 
256:   return OK;
257: }

274:           bk7258_serial_tx_available();

285: static int queue_message(uint8_t logical_channel, uint8_t command,
286:                          uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2, uint32_t p3)
287: {
288:   struct logical_channel *channel;
289:   irqstate_t flags;
290:   unsigned int index;
291:   int ret;
292: 
293:   if (!g_initialized)
294:     {
295:       return -EAGAIN;
296:     }
297: 
298:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
299:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids))
300:     {
301:       return -EINVAL;
302:     }
303: 
304:   flags = up_irq_save();
305:   channel = &g_channels[index];
306:   if (channel->pending)
307:     {
308:       up_irq_restore(flags);
309:       return -EBUSY;
310:     }
311: 
312:   channel->message.header = command;
313:   channel->message.param1 = p1;
314:   channel->message.param2 = p2;
315:   channel->message.param3 = p3;
316:   channel->pending = true;
317:   ret = dispatch_locked();
318:   up_irq_restore(flags);
319:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
320:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
321: }

323: static bool valid_cp_message(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire,
324:                              uintptr_t *address)
325: {
326:   *address = wire->data[0];
327:   /* Armino's mbox0_adapter mailbox_buff is an array of 16-byte messages in
328:    * CP .bss and is only word-aligned; 32-byte alignment is reserved for the
329:    * separate exchange payload buffers. */
330:   return wire->src_cpu == 0 && wire->data[1] == sizeof(struct mb_message) &&
331:          (*address & 3u) == 0 && *address >= CP_RAM_START &&
332:          *address <= CP_RAM_END - sizeof(struct mb_message);
333: }

335: static void handle_ack(struct mb_message *message)
336: {
337:   uint8_t logical_channel = message->header >> 24;
338:   uint8_t sequence = message->header >> 16;
339:   bool uart_failed;
340:   unsigned int index;
341: 
342:   if ((message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_RESET << 12)) != 0)
343:     {
344:       g_stats.reset_count++;
345:       g_phy_busy = false;
346:       (void)dispatch_locked();
347:       return;
348:     }
349: 
350:   if (logical_channel != g_active_channel || sequence != g_active_seq)
351:     {
352:       /* An ACK from a timed-out transmission may arrive after the same
353:        * logical channel has already been retried with a new sequence. It is
354:        * stale and must not release the current in-flight transaction. */
355:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
356:       return;
357:     }
358: 
359:   index = channel_index(g_active_channel);
360:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids) || !g_channels[index].pending)
361:     {
362:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
363:       g_phy_busy = false;
364:       (void)dispatch_locked();
365:       return;
366:     }
367: 
368:   g_channels[index].pending = false;
369:   if (g_active_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_TX)
370:     {
371:       uart_failed =
372:         (message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8)) != 0 ||
373:         (message->param1 & 2u) != 0;
374:       if (uart_failed)
375:         {
376:           g_stats.uart_tx_fail++;
377:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
378:           g_uart_retry_after = clock_systime_ticks() + TX_RETRY_INTERVAL;
379:         }
380:       else
381:         {
382:           g_uart_read = (g_uart_read + g_uart_inflight) % UART_TX_SIZE;
383:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
384:           g_uart_retry_after = 0;
385:           g_serial_kick = true;
386:         }
387: 
388:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
389:     }
390: 
391:   g_phy_busy = false;
392:   uart_prepare();
393:   (void)dispatch_locked();
394: }

396: static void mailbox_rx(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire)
397: {
398:   struct mb_message message;
399:   uintptr_t address;
400:   uint8_t control;
401:   uint8_t logical_channel;
402:   irqstate_t flags;
403: 
404:   if (!valid_cp_message(wire, &address))
405:     {
406:       g_stats.bad_envelope++;
407:       g_stats.last_bad_address = wire->data[0];
408:       g_stats.last_bad_length = wire->data[1];
409:       g_stats.last_bad_source = wire->src_cpu;
410:       return;
411:     }
412: 
413:   memcpy(&message, (const void *)address, sizeof(message));
414:   control = (message.header >> 12) & 0x0fu;
415:   logical_channel = message.header >> 24;
416:   g_stats.rx_count++;
417: 
418:   flags = up_irq_save();
419:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
420:     {
421:       handle_ack(&message);
422:       up_irq_restore(flags);
423:       return;
424:     }
425: 
426:   if ((logical_channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
427:     {
428:       g_stats.unsupported_channel++;
429:       g_stats.last_bad_channel = logical_channel;
430:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
431:     }
432:   else if (logical_channel != MB_CHNL_PWC_RX &&
433:            logical_channel != MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
434:     {
435:       /* Match the vendor mailbox channel layer: a valid channel without a
436:        * registered receiver still gets a COM_FAIL transport ACK. Returning
437:        * without the ACK leaves CP's physical channel BUSY and blocks higher
438:        * priority PWC responses queued behind this message.
439:        */
440: 
441:       g_stats.unsupported_channel++;
442:       g_stats.last_bad_channel = logical_channel;
443:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
444:     }
445: 
446:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
447:     {
448:       /* This port is output-only. Acknowledge Armino's state/data commands
449:        * with RTS deasserted without injecting CP CLI input into AP serial. */
450:       if ((message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_DATA &&
451:           (message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
452:         {
453:           message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
454:         }
455: 
456:       message.param1 = 0; /* uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0 */
457:       message.param2 = 0;
458:       message.param3 = 0;
459:     }
460: 
461:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
462:     {
463:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12;
464:       memcpy((void *)address, &message, sizeof(message));
465:       memcpy(&g_ack_message, &message, sizeof(g_ack_message));
466:       g_ack_wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&g_ack_message;
467:       g_ack_wire[1] = sizeof(g_ack_message);
468:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
469:       if (bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire) < 0)
470:         {
471:           g_stats.fifo_full++;
472:           nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
473:         }
474:       else
475:         {
476:           g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
477:           g_stats.tx_count++;
478:         }
479: 
480:       message.header &= ~((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12);
481:     }
482: 
483:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
484:     {
485:       g_pwc_rx(&message);
486:     }
487: 
488:   up_irq_restore(flags);
489: }

17: #include "irq.h"
18: 
19: #define MBOX_REG(n) (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
20: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG MBOX_REG(0x20)
21: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG MBOX_REG(0x21)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x22)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x23)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TID MBOX_REG(0x24)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_SID MBOX_REG(0x25)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x26)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x27)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x28)
29: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x18)
30: #define MBOX_CTRL MBOX_REG(2)
31: #define MBOX_INT_STATUS MBOX_REG(3)
32: 
33: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
34: static bool g_mbox_ready;
35: 
36: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
37: {
38:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
39: }
40: 
41: int bk7258_mbox_receive(bk7258_mbox_message_t *message)
42: {
43:   if (message == NULL || (bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) != 0)
44:     {
45:       return -EINVAL;
46:     }
47: 
48:   message->src_cpu = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0xfu;
49:   message->data[0] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
50:   message->data[1] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
51:   return OK;
52: }
53: 
54: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
55: {
56:   /* TX uses the CPU1-owned channel 1 registers, while the destination FIFO
57:    * full state is reported by the destination channel (CPU0 is channel 0). */
58:   if (destination > 2 || data == NULL ||
59:       (getreg32(destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS) & 1u) != 0)
60:     {
61:       return -EAGAIN;
62:     }
63: 
64:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
65:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
66:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
67:   return OK;
68: }
69: 
70: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
71: {
72:   bk7258_mbox_message_t message;
73:   (void)irq;
74:   (void)context;
75:   (void)arg;
76: 
77:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
78:     {
79:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&message) != OK)
80:         {
81:           break;
82:         }
83:       if (g_callback != NULL)
84:         {
85:           g_callback(&message);
86:         }
87:     }
88:   return OK;
89: }
90: 
91: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
92: {
93:   g_callback = callback;
94: }
95: 
96: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
97: {
98:   int ret;
99: 
100:   g_mbox_ready = false;
101:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1: FIFO starts at 2 and has three entries. */
102:   /* Channel 1 owns FIFO entries 2..4.  The start and length fields live in
103:    * separate registers on mailbox v2. */
104:   putreg32(2u | (1u << 8), MBOX_CH1_CFG);
105:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
106:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
107:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
108:   if (ret < 0)
109:     {
110:       return ret;
111:     }
112:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
113:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
114:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
115:     {
116:       bk7258_mbox_message_t ignored;
117:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&ignored) != OK)
118:         {
119:           break;
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:   g_mbox_ready = true;
124:   return OK;
125: }

1: /* SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 */
2: 
3: OUTPUT_FORMAT("elf32-littlearm", "elf32-bigarm", "elf32-littlearm")
4: OUTPUT_ARCH(arm)
5: ENTRY(__start)
6: 
7: /* g_bk7258_boot_vectors and _vectors (bk7258_vectors.c) are matched into
8:  * the .bk_boot_vectors / .ram_vectors output sections below purely by
9:  * input section name.  Nothing in the C code references either symbol
10:  * directly, so without this EXTERN() the linker never has a reason to
11:  * pull bk7258_vectors.o out of libarch.a in the first place: KEEP() only
12:  * protects sections that are already part of the link from
13:  * --gc-sections, it does not force extraction of an otherwise-unused
14:  * static archive member.  Without this, both output sections silently
15:  * come out empty (verified via nuttx.map) and the boot/runtime vector
16:  * tables are missing at runtime, not just failing the size ASSERT below.
17:  */
18: EXTERN(g_bk7258_boot_vectors)
19: EXTERN(_vectors)
20: 
21: MEMORY
22: {
23:   FLASH (rx)  : ORIGIN = 0x02150000, LENGTH = 0x00110000
24:   RAM   (rwx) : ORIGIN = 0x28010000, LENGTH = 0x00054000
25:   PSRAM_SECTION (rw) : ORIGIN = 0x60a00000, LENGTH = 0x00600000
26: }
27: 
28: __ap_ram_start = ORIGIN(RAM);
29: __ap_ram_end = ORIGIN(RAM) + LENGTH(RAM);
30: 
31: SECTIONS
32: {
33:   .bk_boot_vectors ORIGIN(FLASH) : ALIGN(512)
34:   {
35:     KEEP(*(.bk_boot_vectors))
36:   } > FLASH
37: 
38:   .gnu.sgstubs : ALIGN(32)
39:   {
40:     KEEP(*(.gnu.sgstubs*))
41:   } > FLASH
42: 
43:   .text : ALIGN(4)
44:   {
45:     _stext = .;
46:     KEEP(*(.start_text))
47:     *(.text .text.*)
48:     *(.rodata .rodata.*)
49:     KEEP(*(.init))
50:     KEEP(*(.fini))
51:     _etext = .;
52:   } > FLASH
53: 
54:   .init_array : ALIGN(4)
55:   {
56:     __init_array_start = .;
57:     KEEP(*(SORT_BY_INIT_PRIORITY(.init_array.*)))
58:     KEEP(*(.init_array))
59:     __init_array_end = .;
60:   } > FLASH
61: 
62:   .ARM.extab : ALIGN(4)
63:   {
64:     *(.ARM.extab* .gnu.linkonce.armextab.*)
65:   } > FLASH
66: 
67:   __exidx_start = .;
68:   .ARM.exidx : ALIGN(4)
69:   {
70:     *(.ARM.exidx* .gnu.linkonce.armexidx.*)
71:   } > FLASH
72:   __exidx_end = .;
73: 
74:   .data : ALIGN(8)
75:   {
76:     _sdata = .;
77:     *(.data .data.* .sdata .sdata.*)
78:     _edata = .;
79:   } > RAM AT > FLASH
80:   _eronly = LOADADDR(.data);
81: 
82:   .ram_vectors : ALIGN(512)
83:   {
84:     __ram_vectors_start = .;
85:     KEEP(*(.ram_vectors))
86:     __ram_vectors_end = .;
87:   } > RAM AT > FLASH
88:   __ram_vectors_load = LOADADDR(.ram_vectors);
89: 
90:   .bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
91:   {
92:     _sbss = .;
93:     *(.bss .bss.* .sbss .sbss.*)
94:     *(COMMON)
95:     _ebss = .;
96:   } > RAM
97: 
98:   .noinit (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
99:   {
100:     *(.noinit .noinit.*)
101:   } > RAM
102: 
103:   .idle_stack (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
104:   {
105:     __idle_stack_base = .;
106:     . += 0x1000;
107:     __idle_stack_top = .;
108:   } > RAM
109: 
110:   .psram.data : ALIGN(8)
111:   {
112:     __ap_psram_data_start = .;
113:     *(.psram.data .psram.data.*)
114:     __ap_psram_data_end = .;
115:   } > PSRAM_SECTION AT > FLASH
116: 
117:   .psram.bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
118:   {
119:     __ap_psram_bss_start = .;
120:     *(.psram.bss .psram.bss.*)
121:     __ap_psram_bss_end = .;
122:   } > PSRAM_SECTION
123: 
124:   .psram.noinit (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
125:   {
126:     __ap_psram_noinit_start = .;
127:     *(.psram.noinit .psram.noinit.*)
128:     __ap_psram_noinit_end = .;
129:   } > PSRAM_SECTION
130: 
131:   __ap_psram_section_start = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION);
132:   __ap_psram_section_end = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION) + LENGTH(PSRAM_SECTION);
133: 
134:   __heap_start = ALIGN(ADDR(.idle_stack) + SIZEOF(.idle_stack), 8);
135:   __heap_end = __ap_ram_end;
136:   _eram = __ap_ram_end;
137: 
138:   /DISCARD/ :
139:   {
140:     *(.note .note.*)
141:     *(.comment)
142:   }
143: 
144:   ASSERT(ADDR(.bk_boot_vectors) == ORIGIN(FLASH),
145:          "AP boot vector is not at image offset zero")
146:   ASSERT((ADDR(.bk_boot_vectors) & 0x1ff) == 0,
147:          "AP boot vector is not 512-byte aligned")
148:   ASSERT((ADDR(.ram_vectors) & 0x1ff) == 0,
149:          "AP runtime vector is not 512-byte aligned")
150:   ASSERT(SIZEOF(.bk_boot_vectors) >= 0x108,
151:          "AP boot vector does not contain BK legacy magic")
152:   ASSERT(_ebss <= __ap_ram_end, "AP bss overlaps CP RAM")
153:   ASSERT(__heap_start < __heap_end, "AP heap is empty")
154:   ASSERT(__heap_end <= __ap_ram_end, "AP heap overlaps CP RAM")
155:   ASSERT(ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION) == 0x60a00000,
156:          "AP PSRAM section base mismatch")
157:   ASSERT(LENGTH(PSRAM_SECTION) == 0x00600000,
158:          "AP PSRAM section size mismatch")
159:   ASSERT(__ap_psram_section_end == 0x61000000,
160:          "16 MB PSRAM layout end mismatch")
161:   ASSERT(SIZEOF(.psram.data) == 0,
162:          ".psram.data requires reset-stage copy support")
163:   ASSERT(SIZEOF(.psram.bss) == 0,
164:          ".psram.bss requires reset-stage clear support")
165:   ASSERT(SIZEOF(.psram.noinit) == 0,
166:          ".psram.noinit is not enabled for the initial PSRAM port")
167: }

47: #define AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE 256
48: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX 3
49: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS  10
50: #define AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS  50
51: 
52: static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;
53: static beken_thread_t s_ap_uart0_log_thread;
54: static volatile uint32_t s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail;
55: 
56: static void ap_uart0_log_output(const uint8_t *line, u16 length)
57: {
58: 	static const uint8_t prefix[] = "ap0: ";
59: 	uint8_t output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
60: 	u16 output_length;
61: 	u8 retry;
62: 
63: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
64: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
65: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
66: 
67: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
68: 	{
69: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
70: 		{
71: 			return;
72: 		}
73: 
74: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
78: }
79: 
80: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
81: {
82: 	(void)param;
83: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
84: }
85: 
86: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
87: {
88: 	uint8_t input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
89: 	uint8_t line[AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
90: 	u16 line_length = 0;
91: 
92: 	(void)arg;
93: 	for (;;)
94: 	{
95: 		u16 input_length;
96: 		u16 index;
97: 		bk_err_t ret;
98: 
99: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem,
100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
104: 			line_length = 0;
105: 			continue;
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		do
109: 		{
110: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
111: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
112: 			{
113: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
114: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
115: 				{
116: 					ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}
120: 		} while (input_length != 0);
121: 	}
122: }
123: 
124: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
125: {
126: 	bk_err_t ret;
127: 
128: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
129: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
130: 	{
131: 		return ret;
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
135: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
136: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
137: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
138: 	{
139: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
140: 		return ret;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
144: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
145: 	{
146: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
147: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
148: 		return ret;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
152: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
153: 	{
154: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
155: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
156: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
157: 		return ret;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
161: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
162: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
163: 	return BK_OK;
164: }

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | CP 启动时初始化 PSRAM，并提供 AP 日志转发 |
12: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
13: 
14: `driver.c`还包含 CP shell 队列串行化、AP 日志按行缓存、`ap0:`来源前缀、
15: 50 ms 半行刷新和队列提交失败有限重试。
16: 
17: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
18: 七区域布局：
19: 
20: ```text
21: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
22: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
23: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
24: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
25: ```
26: 
27: ## 2. 同步到 SMP 工作树
28: 
29: 从工作区根目录执行：
30: 
31: ```bash
32: cp \
33:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
34:   bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
35: 
36: cp \
37:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv \
38:   bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
39: ```
40: 
41: 同步后必须逐字节检查：
42: 
43: ```bash
44: cmp -s \
45:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
46:   bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
47: 
48: cmp -s \
49:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv \
50:   bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
51: ```
52: 
53: 两个`cmp`都必须返回0。
54: 
55: ## 3. 正确构建链条
56: 
57: 最终固件链条固定为：
58: 
59: ```text
60: OpenVela nuttx.bin
61:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
62:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN

51:  *   setting up interrupt service routines, starting the clock, and
52:  *   registering device drivers are some of the things that are different
53:  *   for each processor and hardware platform.
54:  *
55:  *   up_initialize is called after the OS initialized but before the user
56:  *   initialization logic has been started and before the libraries have
57:  *   been initialized.  OS services and driver services are available.
58:  *
59:  ****************************************************************************/

61: void up_initialize(void)
62: {
63:   /* Add any extra memory fragments to the memory manager */
64: 
65:   arm_addregion();
66: 
67: #ifdef CONFIG_PM
68:   /* Initialize the power management subsystem.  This MCU-specific function
69:    * must be called *very* early in the initialization sequence *before* any
70:    * other device drivers are initialized (since they may attempt to register
71:    * with the power management subsystem).
72:    */
73: 
74:   arm_pminitialize();
75: #endif

77: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_DMA
78:   /* Initialize the DMA subsystem if the weak function arm_dma_initialize has
79:    * been brought into the build
80:    */
81: 
82: #ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_WEAKFUNCTIONS
83:   if (arm_dma_initialize)
84: #endif
85:     {
86:       arm_dma_initialize();
87:     }
88: #endif

90:   /* Initialize the serial device driver */
91: 
92: #ifdef USE_SERIALDRIVER
93:   arm_serialinit();

95:

97: 
98:   arm_netinitialize();
99:

101:   /* Initialize USB -- device and/or host */

**Findings**
1. **[严重] §6.3、§6.4、§9.2 把 RESET 描述成“请求并等待 RESET ACK”的双向握手，但现有 CP 协议不是这种状态机，按文档实现会卡在 RESETTING。** 原厂 AP 的 reset 实际发送一个置有 `ACK_BOX|RESET` 的 ACK-box 消息，而不是普通 command；CP 只在自己存在 active TX 时用它合成该事务的 `COM_FAIL` completion，CP 空闲时直接忽略，并且不会向 AP 返回 RESET ACK：[mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:586)、[CP mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:316)。因此文档中的“reset完成”“返回RESET ACK”“AP启动主动RESET并等待有界完成”均无现有源码基础。必须二选一：明确沿用原厂单向 abort 语义，并以之后成功的 STATE/普通事务确认链路；或者定义真正的双向 reset handshake，同时把 AP、CP 两侧 `mailbox_channel.c` 和 wire 兼容策略列入修改及覆盖范围。

2. **[严重] §8.4、§9.3、§12.3 承诺 CP 在 AP reset/link-down 时自动退出 `AP_CONSOLE`，但当前 CP 没有可供 bridge 使用的 reset/link-down 通知。** CP reset 分支在本端 TX idle 时直接返回；非 idle 时也只伪造一次 TX completion，没有 link callback：[CP mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:316)。`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`只暴露并清除 overflow/parity，没有 reset/down 状态：[mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:953)。文档必须增加 CP transport reset/heartbeat/PWC 状态到 bridge 的明确通知路径，并将 `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c`及对应头文件加入 §10.2 覆盖；否则删除“自动退出”和对应验收项。

3. **[严重] §3.2、§6.1、§6.2 所称“稳定 CP message slot 窗口”没有可实施的地址 ABI，且“message slot 32 字节对齐”不符合当前 CP 产物。** CP envelope slot 是 `mbox0_adapter.c`中的普通静态 `.bss mailbox_buff`，没有固定 section/linker 地址：[mbox0_adapter.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:11)。当前 map 将其放在 `0x2806673c`，仅 4 字节对齐，任何 CP 链接变化都可能移动：[app.map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/app.map:49958)。文档必须明确选择：修改 CP adapter/linker，把 envelope slots 放入固定、对齐、双方约定的 section；或承认只能校验整个 CP RAM 范围，不能宣称“精确 message 窗口”。前一种方案还需把 `mbox0_adapter.c`、CP linker/CMake 及 external 覆盖列入 §10.2。

4. **[严重] §3.5 的“SWAP和双方message slot窗口统一映射为 RW/XN”权限方向错误，且 §10.1 漏掉真正控制 MPU 的文件。** AP 只需读取 CP-owned envelope slot，不应获得 RW；AP-owned slots 和 AP TX SWAP 才需要写权限。当前 OpenVela MPU 表只显式覆盖 AP RAM、PSRAM和外设，没有覆盖 CP RAM或 `0x2809f800` SWAP：[bk7258_start.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:41)。`mpu_initialize(..., false, true)`打开 privileged default map，所以目前内核访问可能不 fault，但不会得到文档承诺的 shareable/non-cacheable 属性：[bk7258_start.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c:128)、[arm_mpu.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_mpu.c:336)。文档应要求在 `bk7258_start.c`增加独立共享 MPU region，CP-owned envelope 至少 RO/XN，SWAP按方向和硬件允许范围设 RW/XN，并把该文件及 MPU region 数量检查加入修改清单和验收。

5. **[严重] §3.4、§7.3 的严格保留字段校验与 §11 阶段 C 的测试顺序冲突；未先加固 CP 时，合法 CP DATA/ACK 会被 AP 拒绝。** CP 构造 DATA/STATE 使用未清零的栈 `mb_uart_cmd_t`，只赋值到 offset 11，offset 12..15 未初始化：[mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:536)、[mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:581)。CP 生成 ACK 时只覆盖 offset 4 的 RTS/fail 位，offset 5..15继续保留原 command 内容：[mb_uart_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c:276)、[CP mailbox_channel.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:491)。所以“ACK offset 5..15 必须为0”和 AP 端严格拒绝非零尾部，只有在 CP 同步修改后才兼容。CP command/ACK 全量清零必须前移到阶段 A/C 的前置条件，早于“CP测试任务调用 `bk_mb_uart_write()`驱动NSH”；不能留到阶段 D 或压力验收前。

6. **[高] §9.2、§10.1 所称“在 `up_initialize()`初始化 transport，之后再注册 serial”没有对应的 BK7258 hook，当前文件清单不足以实现该时序。** NuttX 公共 `up_initialize()`直接调用 `arm_serialinit()`，没有 BK7258 transport hook：[arm_initialize.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_initialize.c:61)。当前 `arm_serialinit()`仅注册设备，而 mailbox 直到后续 `bk7258_pwc_start()`才初始化：[bk7258_serial.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:131)、[bk7258_pm_pwc.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:188)。文档应明确由 `arm_serialinit()`在第一次 `uart_register()`前完成 physical transport、logical resources、MB_UART rings/callback 初始化，或明确需要修改公共 ARM init 并说明上游影响；笼统写“arch init入口”不可执行。
